# Verbs

**[arogno-verbs.pdf](arogno-verbs.pdf)** has all of these for printing, one verb per A4 sheet.

One page per verb, listed by dialect infinitive. The first three columns are infinitives. Every page has the same sections. † marks a form that is inferred from the patterns in the course material rather than found in a document. In a column heading it applies to the whole column; beside an infinitive it means the infinitive itself is inferred. The last column here shows how many of a verb's forms were actually found.

Verb classes follow the four conjugations used in Western Lombard grammars: 1st in -à (*ciapà*), 2nd in -é (*vedé*), 3rd with no ending (*met*, *scrif*) and 4th in -ì (*capì*). The course material does not name the classes itself; they are assigned here from each verb's infinitive.
